method: Join the 16 existing revenue pathways to the existing product eligibility matrix, then apply current YouTube audience setting and channel quality rules. Preserve video-versus-channel-versus-external contracting distinctions and do not create synthetic RPM.
population: Creator products and videos designated made for kids under actual intent/age-classification rules; not an observed population of child viewers, channels or earnings

classification_rules.inference: Child-directed designation requires official intent-based criteria, not animation graphics alone.
A deliberately child-directed mixed audience is subject to the child-directed rules.
All-ages style or suitability does not by itself prove child-directed monetization restrictions.
Not an authorization to relabel genuinely child-directed works.
An 18+ age gate is conceptually different from intended child audience designation.

feature_restrictions.source_limit: Disabled personalized ads do not imply no contextual ads, no views or zero revenue; exact payout effect unmeasured.

pathways.label: Watch-page advertising
pathways.consequence: Personalized ads are disabled; contextual advertising may still appear. Revenue and eligibility are unmeasured.

pathways.label: Shorts Feed advertising
pathways.consequence: Child-directed treatment and the respective monetization module must be independently checked; no universal permission, ban, or payout is asserted.

pathways.label: YouTube Premium allocation
pathways.consequence: Child-directed treatment and the respective monetization module must be independently checked; no universal permission, ban, or payout is asserted.

pathways.label: Channel memberships
pathways.consequence: Official eligibility excludes qualifying child-directed channels; exact channel-level assessment and individual approval remain unknown.

pathways.label: Super Chat and Super Stickers
pathways.consequence: Made-for-kids playback suppresses this native paid interaction; not a statement about unrelated videos.

pathways.label: Super Thanks
pathways.consequence: Made-for-kids playback suppresses this native paid interaction; not a statement about unrelated videos.

pathways.label: Live gifts, Jewels and Rubies
pathways.consequence: Individual child-directed livestreams are ineligible for native live Gifts, distinct from general live program access.

pathways.label: Shopping: own products
pathways.consequence: Official eligibility excludes qualifying child-directed channels; exact channel-level assessment and individual approval remain unknown.

pathways.label: Shopping: affiliate products
pathways.consequence: Official eligibility excludes qualifying child-directed channels; exact channel-level assessment and individual approval remain unknown.

pathways.label: YouTube Creator Partnerships
pathways.consequence: Brand deal facilitation and commercial disclosures require content and advertiser review; no child-directed profitability inferred.

pathways.label: Independently negotiated sponsorship
pathways.consequence: A separate business contract and child-audience safeguards are independently relevant; YouTube cannot verify a creator's external sale.

pathways.label: External affiliate links
pathways.consequence: A separate business contract and child-audience safeguards are independently relevant; YouTube cannot verify a creator's external sale.

quality_review.documented_risk: Official monetization policies state that made-for-kids content with low-quality signals may have restricted ads and channels primarily focused on such content may lose YPP.

research_firebreak: No individual child age or viewer identity inference
All child-directed animation is not equivalent to all animation or all family-friendly content
No personalized ads does not mean all advertising is banned
Do not sum an absent native paid product into an earnings projection
Do not infer any numeric contextual ad RPM or revenue decline
External sponsorship and merchandise require independent legal and platform review and cannot be presumed lawful or profitable
Channel-level restrictions are not automatically identical to video-level restrictions
